question: How long does it take to set up TechSync?
answer: Most teams are up and running in under 30 minutes. Import your contacts from Excel, pick a pipeline template for your industry, and invite your team. On Business and Enterprise plans, our onboarding team will help you migrate and configure everything.

question: We currently use Excel and WhatsApp. Is a CRM overkill for us?
answer: That's exactly who TechSync is built for. If you have more than a handful of leads a week or more than one person selling, a CRM stops leads from slipping through the cracks. TechSync keeps the WhatsApp workflow your team likes, and adds structure around it.

question: Can I import my existing data?
answer: Yes. Import leads, contacts, companies and deals from Excel or CSV with guided column mapping and duplicate detection. We also offer one-click migration from Zoho CRM, HubSpot, Pipedrive and LeadSquared.

question: Does TechSync work on mobile?
answer: Yes. Our Android and iOS apps include the full CRM — leads, pipeline, tasks, calling, check-ins and WhatsApp — with offline mode for field sales teams with patchy connectivity.

question: Where is my data stored, and is it secure?
answer: Your data is hosted in ISO 27001-certified data centres in India, encrypted in transit and at rest, and backed up daily. We support two-factor authentication, role-based access and, on Enterprise, SSO and audit logs.

question: What kind of support do you offer?
answer: Every plan includes access to our Help Center and email support. Growth adds live chat, Business adds priority phone support, and Enterprise customers get a dedicated success manager. Support is available in English and Hindi, Monday to Saturday.
